preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 1000 for N in N_values)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of integers N is between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A_i <= 10**9 for A_i in A_values)
preconditions.description: Each integer A_i in the array is between 0 and 10^9.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.expression: all(output.startswith('YES\n') or output.startswith('NO\n') for output in outputs)
all(len(B) == N and len(C) == N for B, C, N in zip(B_values, C_values, N_values))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of B and C are equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(B) == sorted(A) and sorted(C) == sorted(A) for B, C, A in zip(B_values, C_values, A_values))
postconditions.description: For each test case, B and C are permutations of A.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(B[i:j] == C[i:j] for i in range(1, N+1) for j in range(i, N+1) if (i, j) != (1, N)) for B, C, N in zip(B_values, C_values, N_values))
postconditions.description: For each test case, there does not exist a pair (i, j) such that 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ N and (i, j) ≠ (1, N) for which the subarray B[i:j] is a permutation of subarray C[i:j].
